title: Dragon Bridge Pumpkin
description: A large serpentine dragon made of ornate alphabet blocks arches over a cracked stone bridge, its head carved as a glowing jack-o'-lantern breathing fire. A black raven perches on a large carved pumpkin in the foreground surrounded by scattered candies, while the misty, spooky landscape stretches into the distance under a cloudy twilight sky.
prompt: A majestic dragon constructed from large ornate alphabet blocks and books forms an arch over an old cracked stone bridge. The dragon's head is a glowing carved jack-o'-lantern with fire inside. A black raven sits atop a large detailed pumpkin in the foreground with scattered candies. Spooky misty landscape with bare trees, bats, and a lantern under a cloudy twilight sky with teal and purple tones.
